title: Three-Quarter Post Denial
description: Post defenders play in a three-quarter front on the ball side and step through to the other side as the ball moves from wing to corner.

content.objective: Deny the post entry with a three-quarter front and switch sides correctly as the ball moves.
content.setup: Passers at the wing and corner; post player on the block; post defender.
instructions: Ball at the wing: defender plays three-quarter on the high side, arm across the passing lane.
Pass to the corner: defender steps through in front of the post to the low side.
Pass back to the wing: step back through to the high side.
Passers look for an entry when the defender is late.
Play live on a successful entry.
coachingPoints: Step through in front, not behind.
Arm and leg in the passing lane.
Feel the post with the off hand.
commonMistakes: Going behind the post to change sides.
Standing fully behind on the ball side.
Losing contact and giving up a seal.
content.safety: Defenders play legally: chest up, no reaching across the body, no pushing; stop play on any dangerous contact.
progressions: Full front on the low block.
variations: Front fully and get weak-side help.
successCriteria: No entries conceded on the slow passes.
content.gameApplication: Denying the post entry stops post-ups before they start.
